title: Forecast Journal Update Latency
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:forecast update_epoch=*
| eval update_lag_hours=round((update_epoch-_time)/3600,1)
| stats avg(update_lag_hours) as avg_update_lag, max(update_lag_hours) as worst_update_lag by topic
| sort - avg_update_lag
description: Measures how long it takes to revisit and update a forecast after new information arrives.
value: Forecasts are most useful when refreshed, not frozen; update latency captures whether review habits exist in practice.
implementation: Store an update timestamp for revised forecasts and compare average update lag by topic.
visualization: Table of topics with average forecast update lag in hours.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how long you wait before updating a prediction when new evidence shows up.
